name: Tokitou Touko
source:
An individual under Tatebayashi's command who possesses supernatural powers. As expected, she can control spirits. 
She is actually a very kind woman. She became a soldier for a certain purpose.

"I can put it more simply for you. I'm telling you to bring it on!" — Tokitou Touko.
"Tatebayashi-sama. I'll take my leave now." — Tokitou Touko.
